applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations on site
findings.comment: Transformer pad clearances and reduced clearance conditions cannot be verified. No explicit clearance dimensions are provided on the electrical plan. If any clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are present, Austin Energy Design written approval, verification of 3-hour fire rating, confirmation that locations are not in confined space, and adequate vertical clearances to windows/doors must be documented but are not provided.

Transformer pad hot-stick use area access door side clearance cannot be verified. Electrical plans do not identify which side of each transformer contains the access door or specify the distance from the access door to open areas or adjacent buildings/structures. No dimensions indicate whether the minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or building is provided.

applicableAreas: All four transformer pad locations (northwest near Bldg 2, east central between Bldgs 4-5, southwest near Bldg 8, southeast between Bldgs 6-7)
findings.comment: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted transformers cannot be verified as utility-compatible. All four transformer pads are drawn underneath or immediately adjacent to large existing tree canopies. While the tree list identifies species present on-site including Live Oak, Hackberry, Cedar Elm, and Pecan (marked as Appendix F compliant with 'Y'), the plan does not specify which trees are within 10 feet of each transformer pad or confirm their utility compatibility. No tree species call-outs are provided on the electrical or landscape plans adjacent to transformer locations.

Shrub and low-lying vegetation clearances from transformer pads cannot be verified. The landscape plan does not identify specific shrub/vegetation planting locations relative to transformer access door sides. Clearance requirements of 10 feet from access door side and 5 feet from other sides cannot be confirmed from available plans. Transformer access door orientations are not marked on electrical plans.

Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment lack documented root barriers. The landscape plan does not identify specific trees within 20 feet of transformers or show root barrier details (minimum 4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment). Although large trees exist proximate to all four transformer pads, no root barrier details or specifications are provided on any plan sheets.

Transformer pad clearances from water lines cannot be verified. Transformer pad locations are not shown on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19), which depicts water line routing. Without transformer locations dimensioned in relation to water utilities, the 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified from the submitted plans.

Transformer pad clearances from wastewater lines cannot be verified. Transformer pad locations are not shown on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19), which depicts wastewater line routing. Without transformer locations dimensioned in relation to wastewater utilities, the 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified from the submitted plans.

Transformer pad clearances from storm drain lines cannot be verified. Transformer pad locations are not shown on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19), which depicts storm drain line routing. Without transformer locations dimensioned in relation to storm drain utilities, the 5-foot horizontal clearance requirement cannot be verified from the submitted plans.

Transformer pad clearances from gas lines cannot be verified. No gas utility infrastructure is identified on the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19), which does not show gas service locations or lines. Additionally, transformer pad locations are not shown in relation to utilities on any plan sheet, preventing verification of the 24-36 inch minimum clearance requirement from gas lines.

Transformer pad clearances from other underground utilities cannot be verified. Transformer pad locations are not coordinated with the Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) or shown in relation to any underground utility lines. The 12-inch minimum horizontal and vertical clearance requirement from other underground utilities (except gas, fuel, steam) cannot be verified from submitted plans.

Transformer locations are not coordinated with utility lines on submitted plans. The requirement that transformers not be located over or under utility lines, and that utilities not pass over/under building foundations or transformers, cannot be verified. Transformer locations and utility routing are not shown together on any single plan sheet.

Cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearances in access paths are not provided. No cross-section sheets show vertical clearances from transformer pads to overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas. Vertical clearance compliance for transformer access cannot be verified from available plan documents.

Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs dry-type) is not specified on electrical plans. If oil-filled transformers are proposed, grading plan surface drainage direction must slope away from transformer pads. Current grading plans do not indicate drainage direction relative to transformer locations, and equipment type specification is absent from plans, preventing verification of this requirement.

Transformer easements are not shown on site plan or plat. Required easements around transformer pads for Austin Energy accessibility are not depicted on the plat (Sheet 2), site plan (Sheet 9), or electrical plan (Sheet 21). Easement width required by Austin Energy Design cannot be determined from submitted plans.

Transformer pad dimensions do not match or reference Austin Energy Design-approved specifications. Transformer pad dimensions are not dimensioned or labeled on electrical plans. No AE Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets, specifications, or ESPA documentation is included in the site plan or supplementary documents. Service type (single-phase or three-phase) is not specified, preventing verification of compliance with AE Design requirements.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes
findings.comment: Bollards are not shown or specified on electrical plans. If transformer pads are installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle circulation routes, required 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details are not depicted or dimensioned on the electrical plan. No AE Design equipment pad details showing bollard specifications are provided with the submittal.
